question: What triad remains here after release from doubt and contraction?
premises: Here there is release from being-exuberance doubt and contraction.
What remains is own-bliss absorption only.
The triad is will, action, and vision.
inference: After release, the triad of will, action, and vision remains in own-bliss absorption.
plain_english: Here, from release of being-exuberance, doubt, and contraction, remains only own-bliss absorption: the triad of will, action, and vision.
